description:
Append a new page (tab) to the current diagram WITHOUT touching existing pages or unsaved user changes. Use this when the user wants "another diagram alongside" — e.g. "add a CNN page" — instead of create_new_diagram which wipes everything.

Inputs:
- name: optional display name for the tab (defaults to Page-N where N = existing-page-count + 1)
- id: optional explicit page id; if omitted the server generates a short alphanumeric id
- xml: optional starting content: the mxCell elements of the page (root cells "0" and "1" are added), or a bare <mxGraphModel>. If omitted, the page starts blank.

Returns the new page's id, name, and index so the caller can immediately target it with edit_diagram.

id.description: Optional explicit page id. If omitted the server generates one. Must be unique across pages.

name.description: Optional display name for the new tab (e.g. "CNN"). Defaults to "Page-N".

xml.description: Optional starting content: the mxCell elements of the page, or a bare <mxGraphModel>. If omitted the page starts blank.

name: add_page
title: Add page
